inlines.text: Complete the table. Round your answers to 2 decimal places.

answer.worked: $$\begin{align*}\text{Profit/loss}&=\$16-\$20\\\text{Profit/loss}&=-\$4\\\text{Percentage change}&=\frac{-4}{20}\times100\\\text{Percentage change}&=-20\%\end{align*}$$The negative result means a 20% loss.
